name: proposal-fee-to-deal-value

trigger.trigger_note: Catch hook. A Notion database automation POSTs the proposal page here when its Project Fee changes. The SOURCE database is not shared with the Zapier integration (no visible data source carries a 'Project Fee' property), so the payload snapshot is the only input — the page cannot be re-read.

notion.note: Writes Deals 'Value' (number) via a raw page PATCH. An empty Project Fee SKIPS rather than blanking Value (mirror rule: never blank what you failed to read).

replaces_classic_zap: Update Deal Value When Proposal Fee Updated
staleness_flag: As of 2026-08-10 NO data source visible to the work.flowers Zapier integration carries a 'Project Fee' property — the current 'Project Proposals' data source (1d791b07-11ac-8058-8c70-000b0d0dfaf2) has none, and fees appear to have moved to Xero Quotes. The classic Zap's export also showed has_automatic_issues on its Notion step. When repointing the Notion automation (cutover), verify the source database still sends 'Project Fee' + 'Deal'; if the shape changed, the durable throws loudly naming the properties it saw.

description: Proposal webhook from Notion -> copy Project Fee onto the related Deal's Value. Skips on empty fee or missing Deal relation; throws when the payload shape is unrecognizable.
